name: Amphibious
text: This creature is perfectly happy on land or in the water. It automatically passes all Swimming Rolls, treats water as normal instead of rough ground, and suffers no Fight penalties for being in the water.

name: Animal
text: A natural creature with less-than-human intelligence. Even if they become a member of a warband, animals cannot pick up treasure tokens and have no item slots.

name: Antithetical to Magic
text: This creature is completely immune to magic in all forms. It may not be the target of any spell, nor will it suffer damage from any kind of magic attack. A figure in combat with this creature may not use any magic item, and any magic items being carried will temporarily lose all bonuses or effects. A figure may fight with a magic weapon, but treat it as a mundane example of the weapon.

name: Antlers
text: This creature may fight unarmed with its antlers at -1 Fight, with no other unarmed penalty.

name: Aquatic
text: This creature can only live in the water and will never willingly move onto land. If forced onto land, it treats all ground as rough ground for the purposes of movement and must pass a Will Roll (TN16) every time it activates or suffer 5 points of damage. Aquatic creatures never have to make Swimming Rolls, treat water as normal instead of rough ground, and suffer no Fight penalties for being in the water.

name: Aura of Pain
text: If a figure activates within 6" of this creature, the figure must make an immediate Will Roll (TN12) or suffer 2 points of damage. Undead, constructs, and demons are immune to this damage and thus do not have to make a Will Roll.

name: Automatic Damage
text: Any figure that activates while in combat with this creature takes 2 points of elemental magic damage. Creatures with automatic damage are immune to damage from automatic damage.

name: Awkward on Land
text: Despite being Amphibious, this creature's Move is halved while on land.

name: Blood-Marked
text: These creatures gain +5 on all Will Rolls to resist Mind Control or Suggestion. Should a creature with Blood-Marked lose its weapon, it suffers the usual -2 Fight, but not the normal -2 damage.

name: Bounty (X)
text: There is a reward of (X) awaiting the warband that kills this creature.

name: Burning
text: This creature deals +2 damage on a fight it wins, even if it deals no other damage.

name: Burrowing
text: This creature may move through terrain as though it were not there, provided it has enough movement to reach the other side (it cannot end its movement within a solid piece of terrain). Furthermore, the creature never suffers any movement penalty for moving over rough ground.

name: Carry Disease
text: A figure wounded by this creature must pass a Will Roll (TN10) or suffer -2 Health in its next game.

name: Chilling Touch
text: This creature deals +2 damage in combat, except against undead or constructs.

name: Construct
text: This creature is immune to poison and never counts as wounded. Constructs can pick up and carry treasure tokens but have no item slots. Although constructs may never carry items, some items may be permanently grafted to them — if available, this option will be noted in the item's description.

name: Damage Maximum (X)
text: Damage dealt by this creature in a single hit is capped at (X).

name: Demon
text: All attacks made by this creature count as magic attacks. This creature is immune to poison. Demons can pick up and carry treasure tokens but have no item slots.

name: Elemental Blast
text: This creature can make one +3 elemental magic shooting attack every time it activates. It will follow the normal rules for a creature armed with a missile weapon until it makes this attack. Afterwards it follows the rules as though not armed with a missile weapon.

name: Elemental Resistance (X)
text: Whenever this creature takes elemental damage, increase its armour by (X) for the purposes of determining damage from that attack.

name: Elevated View
text: This creature has line of sight to anything not directly under cover, regardless of intervening terrain height.

name: Energy Drain
text: This creature deals double damage in combat. Undead and constructs are immune to this extra damage and just take the standard amount.

name: Ethereal
text: This creature may move through terrain as though it were not there, provided it has enough movement to reach the other side (it cannot end its movement within a solid piece of terrain). Furthermore, the creature never suffers any movement penalty for climbing or moving over rough ground.

name: Expert Climber
text: This creature suffers no movement penalty for climbing.

name: Feeder
text: This creature is removed from the table the moment it makes a kill; the slain figure's Survival Roll suffers -1.

name: Flee From Death
text: A Pack Hunter with this trait immediately flees the table if another figure in its pack is reduced to 0 Health.

name: Flying
text: This creature ignores all terrain and movement penalties when moving. Furthermore, it never takes damage from falling. Flying creatures automatically pass all Swimming Rolls.

name: Giant-blooded
text: This creature deals +1 melee damage and gains +4 to TN-based Fight rolls. Includes the Large trait.

name: Harvest Blood
text: After the game, this creature heals 1 Health for each figure in its warband reduced to 0 Health that game (maximum one source of healing per game).

name: Hate Undead
text: This creature gains +1 Fight, all of its attacks count as magic attacks, and it always moves toward and attacks the nearest undead figure if any are in play.

name: Horns
text: If this creature moves into combat and spends an action to fight as part of the same activation, it receives +2 Fight for that attack only.

name: Hunter's Will (X)
text: This creature gains +2 Will while creature (X) is on the table.

name: Hurl Rock
text: This creature has a 12" ranged attack dealing +4 damage.

name: Immune to (Spell)
text: This creature is immune to a specific spell. Any attempts to cast that spell on the creature automatically fail.

name: Immune to Critical Hits
text: This creature never suffers any extra damage from a critical hit. Its opponent still automatically wins the fight on a roll of 20, but no additional damage is inflicted.

name: Immune to Normal Weapons
text: This creature can only be hurt by magic. This includes all damage caused by magic weapons, and any other attack specifically noted to be magic or to cause magic damage.

name: Immune to Poison
text: This creature is never counted as poisoned.

name: Inspiring
text: Friendly gnolls within 6" of this creature gain +2 Will.

name: Keen Senses
text: This creature treats everything within 6" as being in line of sight.

name: Large
text: This huge creature is easier to target with shooting attacks. It suffers from the Large Target modifier (-2) when defending against shooting attacks.

name: Latch On
text: A creature with this trait cannot be pushed back from combat unless it is dealt damage first.

name: Lava Splash
text: A foe that rolls 5 or less (before modifiers) on its Fight Roll in combat with this creature takes 2 damage.

name: Levitate
text: This creature never suffers any movement penalty for climbing or moving over rough ground.

name: Limited Teleportation
text: Once per activation, this creature may teleport directly into combat with a treasure-carrying figure within range.

name: Magic Attack
text: Any attack made by this creature counts as a magic attack.

name: Magic Attacks (X)
text: This creature's attacks only count as magic attacks against (X).

name: Magic Vulnerability
text: This creature takes +1 damage from all magic attacks.

name: Melt Weapon
text: If a figure that is fighting this creature rolls a natural '1' on their attack roll, then the weapon they are using is immediately destroyed. This attribute has no effect on magic weapons.

name: Mind Lock
text: This creature is Immune to Mind Control and Immune to Suggestion.

name: Never Wounded
text: This creature never counts as wounded.

name: Nimble
text: This creature suffers no movement penalty for rough ground.

name: Opponent Armour Reduction
text: A light- or heavy-armoured figure beaten by this creature in combat has its Armour reduced by 1.

name: Pack Hunter
text: If more than one of these creatures appears at the same time, place them in base contact. Whenever a pack hunter is activated, all other pack hunters in contact with it should be activated and moved as one. Roll randomly to see which creature is the "pack leader" and determine the pack's actions using that figure.

name: Pain-Blink
text: Whenever this creature suffers damage from any source, and is not reduced to 0 Health, immediately move it 6" in a random direction. This may move the creature into or out of combat. If this would move the creature into terrain, place it on top of that terrain. If this would move it onto another figure, place the pain-blink creature in combat with this figure at the point nearest where it should have appeared. If it moves the figure off the table, place it adjacent to the table edge at the point it would have left.

name: Partial Immunity to Normal Damage
text: Non-magic damage dealt to this creature is halved, rounded down.

name: Poison
text: Attacks from this creature are venomous and deal poison damage.

name: Possible Self-Combustion
text: At the end of each turn this creature is on the table roll one die: on a roll of '20', the creature self-combusts and should be replaced with a Burning Man figure at full Health. If a figure is in combat with this creature when it self-combusts, it suffers an immediate +0 Elemental magic attack.

name: Potential Marsh Gas Cloud
text: On a roll of 15 or higher when this creature dies, every figure within 3" must pass a Will Roll (TN12) or take damage.

name: Potential Weapon Destruction
text: Damaging this creature with a non-magic weapon risks the weapon: on a roll of 1-6, it is destroyed.

name: Powerful
text: Damage dealt by this creature is doubled.

name: Prize Taker
text: This creature gains a bonus against figures with the Horns, Antlers, or Bounty traits, and its warband gains +5 XP for killing one.

name: Resistant to Missile Weapons
text: This creature never takes more than 2 points of damage from non-magic bow, crossbow, or javelin attacks. It takes full damage from all other shooting attacks, including attacks made with magic arrows, bolts, or javelins.

name: Rock-hard Skin
text: A natural roll of 1 on a Fight Roll made against this creature breaks the attacker's weapon.

name: Sense Magic
text: For the purposes of determining movement (and nothing else), this creature counts as having line of sight to all spellcasters within 12", and may move into combat with spellcasters even if they are invisible (immediately ending the Invisibility spell).

name: Set Traps
text: This creature may place a 1" trap (maximum three per game); a figure that triggers one suffers +1 damage or must pass a Move Roll (TN20) or lose its next activation.

name: Sharp Teeth
text: This creature deals +1 damage in melee combat.

name: Shooting Attack
text: This creature has a natural ranged attack dealing +0 damage at 12" range, unless otherwise stated.

name: Shrouded Form
text: This creature cannot be seen beyond 12" and gains +3 Fight against shooting attacks.

name: Spell Reflection
text: Any time a spell is successfully cast upon this creature, roll a die: on a 16+ the spell is reflected back on the figure that originally cast the spell. This spellcaster should make any Will Rolls or Combat Rolls required as the target of the spell. This includes any spells that include the creature in their area of effect.

name: Spellcaster
text: This creature can cast spells. Exactly which spells it can cast and how this is handled will be given in the creature's description.

name: Strong
text: This creature does +2 damage.

name: Suicide Attack
text: This creature dies as soon as it inflicts any damage in hand-to-hand combat. So, if this creature attacks another figure in hand-to-hand combat, and inflicts at least 1 point of damage, it is immediately reduced to 0 Health.

name: Supporting Figure Maximum
text: Figures fighting this creature gain a maximum of +2 from supporting figures, regardless of how many are actually supporting.

name: Surprise Attack
text: This creature gains +4 to a Fight Roll made in the same activation it moves into combat.

name: Swarm
text: This creature can move through any gap regardless of size and is Expert Climber by default. It always counts as having one supporting figure in melee. Shooting attacks made with a bow, crossbow, or javelin are capped at 3 damage against it, and hand-to-hand attacks are capped at 6 damage (even if magical). It never leaves an opponent "unarmed", and area-effect spells and attacks (Grenade, Destructive Sphere, Elemental Ball, Scatter Shot, and the like) deal triple damage to it.

name: Target Constructs
text: This creature always moves toward and attacks the nearest warband construct, if any are in play.

name: Terrain Expert (X)
text: This soldier picks a Terrain Expertise (Mountain, Bog, Ice, or Forest) and never consumes supplies. In a game where that terrain type is dominant, it also gains Nimble, and the warband gains +2 Initiative and +2 supply points after the game.

name: Thaumaturgic Vulnerability
text: This creature suffers -1 Will against spells cast by a Thaumaturge.

name: True Sight
text: Ignore any castings of Beauty or Invisibility when determining this creature's actions. Furthermore, if this figure is ever in combat with an Illusionary Soldier, the Illusionary Soldier is immediately removed from the table.

name: Two-Headed
text: Opponents fighting this creature count one fewer supporting figure (minimum 0).

name: Unaggressive Unless Startled
text: This creature moves randomly until it is wounded or an explosive spell is cast nearby, after which it acts normally.

name: Undead
text: This creature is immune to poison and never counts as wounded. Undead creatures can pick up and carry treasure tokens but have no item slots.

name: Wilderness Survival
text: A soldier with this trait consumes no supply unless reduced to 0 Health.
